name: Self-Organizing Gaussian Grids
definition: A compact 3D scene representation that organizes the high-dimensional parameters of 3D Gaussian Splatting into a 2D grid with local homogeneity to reduce storage size without compromising visual quality.
summary: Self-Organizing Gaussian Grids compress 3D Gaussian Splatting by learning a scene-specific permutation into a 2D grid, preserving topology to drastically reduce storage without compromising visual quality.
